articles.summary: Announces Lowe's Partnership, Maintains FY26 Adjusted EBITDA Outlook and Updates Revenue Guidance Traeger, Inc. ("Traeger" or the "Company") (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced its financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Second Quarter FY26 Results Total revenues decreased 17.4% to $120.2 million Grill revenues decreased 17.0% to $61.6 million Net loss of $8.6 million, up 16.0% from $7.4 million in the prior year Adjusted EBITDA
articles.title: Traeger Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
